Chapter 6539: Shocking True Identity

Chapter 6539: Shocking True Identity

The dragon hybrid couldn’t withstand the pressure from Supreme Black Ancestor, ceding the momentum of its weapon.

The struggle unleashed battle cries that shattered stars one after another. Its immortal flame failed to overcome the opponent.

“Crack!” Everyone felt Heaven World was cracking apart, on the verge of collapse.

Supreme Black Ancestor has yet to release his true strength. Any primal ancestor and heaven-slayer could tell he could easily kill them.

In fact, he could devour the whole world in the blink of an eye. Anyone attempting to stop him would only become his meal. The disparity was insurmountable.

“Raa!” The hybrid’s muscles bulged as it flexed all its might, unable to push up. Time and space around it shattered from the pressure.

The weapon was right above its head. The scaled helmet was as tough as an ancestral true dragon but still cracked.

“Bam!” Eventually, it shattered enough to reveal the hybrid’s head, leaving everyone astounded including Supreme Black Ancestor.

Instead of having a gigantic head proportional to its frame, the head was the size of a normal human head.

The stark contrast in size aside, the man was charismatic instead of being ferocious or evil.

He looked to be middle-aged with starry eyes. They were profound and contained numerous mysteries. Alas, they were sealed and the pupil looked like two soul-devouring abysses instead.

If he were to regain his original form, he would be a handsome man with an unmatched aura. Some would mistake him for being a dao source and instinctively respect him. Something about him also drew people closer.

“Nine Secrets.” Supreme Black Ancestor became astounded.

“What?!” Listeners couldn’t believe it.

“That famous progenitor?” A young desolate god heard of this name before.

“That’s the one.” An ancient progenitor gasped, not trusting his own eyes.

“There is only one Nine Secrets in this world, the renowned progenitor and direct disciple of Bao Pu.” A timeworn existence murmured.

Another calmed down and asked: “I thought Nine Secrets participated in Old Strike Pact. Why is he here?”

Few knew about this particular pact but Nine Secrets was among them. It failed utterly and all participants disappeared.

Numerous legends spoke of Nine Secrets. Some stated that there were nine cultivators, not just one. Either way, it was too distant for the current generation.

“Boom!” A terrible power erupted and the dragon hybrid pushed Supreme Black Ancestor away with its weapon.

“So you’re still alive, what did Bao Pu do to you?” Black staggered several steps backward, gazing at the opponent.

No one could connect this creature to the once brilliant cultivator. Something turned the great progenitor into an abomination. Did Bao Pu do this to his disciple? The very thought sent chills down everyone’s spine.

“What happened to him?” Those who knew him felt great sorrow and fear.

“Raa!” Runes appeared on his body and soared into the air.

“The nine words!” Black’s expression darkened.

“Soldiers and fighters, arrange and proceed forward!” A progenitor shouted. [1]

Each rune became massive and formed nine-layered firmament before descending with the force of the high heaven.

1. Didn’t expect to see this again after who knows how many chapters? It started with the Nine Word True Bow back in the nine worlds. ☜
